sections.heading: Welcome aboard Ventura
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D companion for P&O Cruises Ventura. Use this guide for planning, but always follow official ship announcements, signage and crew advice.

sections.heading: Finding your way around
sections.body: Ventura has 14 guest decks. Deck names include P (5), F (6), Prom (7), E (8), D (9), C (10), B (11), A (12), Riviera (14), Lido (15), Sun (16), Sports (17), Sky (18) and Ocean (19). There is also a G Deck shown on the official plan. Check individual venue locations using the official P&O Cruises Ventura deck plan: https://www.pocruises.com/content/dam/po/inventory-assets/ships/VE/Ventura-Deck-Plan-W26-27.pdf

sections.heading: Dining on Ventura
sections.body: Main dining: Bay Tree, Saffron and Cinnamon. Casual options include Waterside buffet and poolside pizzeria and grill. Speciality options include Epicurean, Sindhu, The Beach House and The Glass House. Dining formats, opening hours, availability and supplements can change: check onboard.

sections.heading: Bars and evening entertainment
sections.body: Explore the Arena Theatre, Havana, The Tamarind Club, The Exchange, Red Bar and Metropolis. Consult the daily programme for performance times and reservations.

sections.heading: Pools, wellness and family activities
sections.body: Ventura has four pools and facilities including the Oasis Spa, The Retreat, Sports Arena, video game arcade and children’s activities. Some facilities require bookings, fees or age restrictions.

sections.heading: Embarkation and sea days
sections.body: Before boarding, check your embarkation time, travel documents and any official messages. On sea days, use the Daily Planner to note shows, dining reservations and activities. Follow the crew’s safety and muster instructions.

sections.heading: Going ashore
sections.body: Check the ship’s local-time clock, all-aboard time and official port notices before leaving. Take required travel documents and allow extra time to return; itineraries can change.

sections.heading: Share this free guide
sections.body: Use Share App in the menu to show the Ventura QR code, linking to https://elevor360.github.io/Ventura-Cruise-app/.
